figurative_meaning_en: To surround with fire and burn to death
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা প্রতিহিংসায় বেড়া-আগুনে পোড়ানোর চেষ্টা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The enemies were burned in a fence of fire on the battlefield.
They tried to burn him alive in vengeance by surrounding him with fire.
note: Evokes imagery of traditional rural punishment methods in Bengali folklore
